FIELD STUDY
The stopped clock · Workshop · 6 patience

Repair the clockwork and set it to the garden sundial. Combine tools, open the cabinet, then wind the repaired clock.

Scenario book: three different adventures. Restart chooses an adventure; use the selector before beginning a route if you want a specific one.

Adventure 
The stopped clock
The storm observatory
The flooded cellar

handle

Selected: Visit Workshop

Field guide
Choose an adventure from the selector: a stopped clock, storm observatory or flooded cellar. Their item dependencies and access conditions differ.
Collect items, select an inventory item, then use a fixture. The stopped-clock tools must be combined; the storm has independent power and optics branches; the cellar opens after pumping.
Read clues, prepare the exit mechanism and choose its setting. Six incompatible actions end the adventure. Restart or change adventure clears all progress.

No timer. Every control works with touch or Tab + Enter / Space. Restart returns to a fresh expedition.
